title: Episode 39: How Steve Jobs Saved Sean Parent

sentences.en: Please tell me that this is like a PG-13, like, and then we lost it because you're telling me all the names and I was like, did we lose Trent?
sentences.zh: 求你了，告诉我这顶多算是个PG-13级，呃，然后我们就听呆了，因为你刚才报了所有人名，我当时就在想：特伦特（Trent）不会没了吧？

sentences.en: Did we lose someone?
sentences.zh: 我们有人遇难了吗？

sentences.en: And that's why we're being so specific.
sentences.zh: 所以我们才讲得这么具体。

sentences.en: And okay, everyone's alive.
sentences.zh: 好吧，大家都活着。

sentences.en: Everyone's alive.
sentences.zh: 大家都活着。

sentences.en: Welcome to ADSP, the podcast, episode 39, recorded on July 28th, 2021.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收看ADSP播客，今天是第39期，录制于2021年7月28日。

sentences.en: My name is Connor, and today with my co-host, Bryce, we interview Sean Parent, and he tells us the story of how Apple Sudham and Steve Jobs stepped in to save the day.
sentences.zh: 我是康纳（Connor），今天我和我的联合主持人布莱斯（Bryce），采访了肖恩·帕伦特（Sean Parent），他给我们讲了苹果苏丹和史蒂夫·乔布斯出手救场的故事。

sentences.en: I've had Sean tell the story about the time that Photoshop crashed during Chinese New Year and created like an international incident, and Sean got it all from a U.S.
sentences.zh: 我曾听肖恩讲过一次，当年Photoshop在农历新年期间崩溃，引发了一场类似国际事件的风波，而且肖恩的消息还是从一个美国参议员那里听来的。

sentences.en: senator or something.
sentences.zh: 我们在这儿聊过这个故事吗？

sentences.en: Have we had that story here?
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: So yeah, you're referring to what's known as the Basimatic story, which I'm going to put that one on the shelf because that one, you know, it gets,
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你指的是那个所谓的“巴西马里克（Basimatic）”故事，我要把它先搁在一边，因为这个故事，你知道的，它……

sentences.en: that's a story for drinks over the bar.
sentences.zh: 那是个适合在酒吧喝酒时聊的故事。

sentences.en: There's still some people who are very sensitive to that story, so they tend to not go public.
sentences.zh: 到现在还有些人对这个故事非常敏感，所以他们往往不会公开。

sentences.en: And if Sean says it's too sensitive to be repeated, then you can take it that time.
sentences.zh: 既然肖恩说敏感得不能重复，那你就当没这回事吧。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So we'll leave that one hanging out there for your listeners.
sentences.zh: 所以我们就给你的听众留个悬念吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, so kind of, you know, in conversations and on Twitter, two stories came up.
sentences.zh: 对，所以呢，在平时的聊天和推特上，冒出了两个故事。

sentences.en: So I'll let you guys flip the coin and choose.
sentences.zh: 那我就让你们抛个硬币来选一个吧。

sentences.en: One was the one that Tony mentioned, which he was kind of mentioning the punchline, which he said, you know, wasn't there, I forget how he phrased it,
sentences.zh: 一个是托尼（Tony）提到的那个，他当时算是提到了包袱底，他说，呃，记不清他是怎么措辞的了，

sentences.en: but wasn't there an individual after the whole Cyan proposal, which was the story we told before, who said that he had been asked at Apple to figure out why that couldn't work.
sentences.zh: 但不是说在整个锡安（Cyan）提案之后——就是我们之前讲过的那个故事——有人说过，苹果曾找过他，让他去研究为什么那个提案行不通吗？

sentences.en: And he saw my name at the top of the paper and said, oh, no, it'll work.
sentences.zh: 然后他看到文件顶上写着我的名字，就说，哦不，这绝对行得通。

sentences.en: So that's the punchline of the story, but there's a good story for how we get there.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是那个包袱，不过我们是怎么走到这一步的，也是个精彩的故事。

sentences.en: The other story is how I, at one point, Apple sued me, and it was Steve Jobs who actually saved me.
sentences.zh: 另一个故事是，有一次苹果起诉了我，而真正救了我的其实是史蒂夫·乔布斯。

sentences.en: I think we got to hear how Steve Jobs saved Sean.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们必须听听史蒂夫·乔布斯是怎么救了肖恩的。

sentences.en: And don't worry, listeners, we're not going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 听众朋友们别担心，我们哪儿也不去。

sentences.en: I mean, at leaSt...
sentences.zh: 我是说，至少……

sentences.en: Story time with Sean is a recurring segment.
sentences.zh: “肖恩故事时间”是个常设环节。

sentences.en: At one point, I think, I told Sean that he should have his own podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我记得我跟肖恩说，他应该自己开个播客。

sentences.en: And he said, no, I don't have time for that.
sentences.zh: 他说，不，我没时间搞那个。

sentences.en: I don't have the bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 我没有这个精力。

sentences.en: He said, however, if you had a podcast and you just wanted to be a recurring guest, I'd be more than happy to do that.
sentences.zh: 他说，不过，如果你有个播客，而我只需要当个常驻嘉宾，那我非常乐意。

sentences.en: And I said, okay, done.
sentences.zh: 我说，行，那就这么定了。

sentences.en: Okay, so story time here.
sentences.zh: 好，接下来是故事时间。

sentences.en: So this goes way back, and it's a little kind of outside of tech, but, you know, ties into tech.
sentences.zh: 这事得追溯到很久以前，其实有点偏离科技圈，但呢，又跟科技沾边。

sentences.en: I was in college, so the year is 1984.
sentences.zh: 我那时还在上大学，那是1984年。

sentences.en: I had to look this up, and I believe it was 84, and it kind of spans into 85 for the length of the story here.
sentences.zh: 我特意去查了一下，应该是在84年，故事的发展一直延续到了85年。

sentences.en: And I was working at a computer reseller called Microcomputer SysteMs.
sentences.zh: 当时我在一家名为“微型计算机系统”的电脑经销商那里工作。

sentences.en: They were in Bellevue Square, for anybody who knows the Seattle area.
sentences.zh: 对任何了解西雅图地区的人来说，他们就在贝尔维尤广场（Bellevue Square）。

sentences.en: So it's a mall, and, you know, selling computers at a mall.
sentences.zh: 那是一个购物中心，你知道的，就是在商场里卖电脑。

sentences.en: And they were an Apple dealer before Apple had their own stores.
sentences.zh: 在苹果拥有自己的专卖店之前，他们就是苹果的经销商。

sentences.en: And the Macintosh was newly out, and Apple ran a sales promotion for the Macintosh that was called I'd Rather Be Driving a Macintosh.
sentences.zh: 当时麦金塔（Macintosh）刚问世，苹果为麦金塔举办了一场名为“我宁愿开麦金塔”的促销活动。

sentences.en: And, in fact, I still have a bumper sticker.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我还留着一张汽车贴纸呢。

sentences.en: You can probably find images of these bumper stickers online.
sentences.zh: 你可能还能在网上找到这些贴纸的照片。

sentences.en: So I've got a bumper sticker with the rainbow Apple logo that says I'd Rather Be Driving a Macintosh.
sentences.zh: 所以我有一张带有彩虹苹果标志的贴纸，上面写着“我宁愿开麦金塔”。

sentences.en: And the basic idea of the promotion is it was trying to get people in to test drive a Macintosh at an Apple dealer.
sentences.zh: 这个促销活动的基本理念是，吸引人们到苹果经销商那里去试驾麦金塔。

sentences.en: And so you could schedule a time to come into an Apple dealer, and they would kind of walk you through a canned demo and try to convince you to buy a Mac.
sentences.zh: 你可以预约时间去苹果经销商那里，他们会带你过一遍标准演示，试着说服你买一台Mac。

sentences.en: And part of the test drive is you could even take a Mac home for, like, a week and try it out and then bring it back as kind of a test drive.
sentences.zh: 作为试驾的一部分，你甚至可以把一台Mac带回家用上一周左右，体验一下再还回来，就当是试驾了。

sentences.en: So part of the sales promotion was a spiff for the Apple salespeople, where for every 10 Macintoshes you sold, you got entered into a drawing to win a Porsche 944 for a year.
sentences.zh: 所以促销活动的一部分是给苹果销售人员的奖励，每卖出10台麦金塔，你就能获得一次抽奖机会，赢取一辆保时捷944一年的使用权。

sentences.en: It would be a one-year lease on this car.
sentences.zh: 这辆车是一年的租赁期。

sentences.en: Wow, that's pretty cool.
sentences.zh: 哇，那太酷了。

sentences.en: Pretty cool.
sentences.zh: 相当酷。

sentences.en: And there was just, you know, across all the Apple dealers, you know, across the whole country, there was one Porsche 944 that was going to be given out in this drawing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，在全美所有的苹果经销商中，这次抽奖只会送出一辆保时捷944。

sentences.en: And at our store, we pooled all of our Mac sales under our manager's name.
sentences.zh: 在我们店里，我们把所有的Mac销量都归到了我们经理的名下。

sentences.en: Our manager was Ron to maximize our number of chances to win this car, and Ron won.
sentences.zh: 我们经理叫罗恩（Ron），这样能最大化我们赢得这辆的机会，结果罗恩真的赢了。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So we agreed, and Ron agreed, that what we would do is, once we, you know, had the car with the year lease, is we would just divvy up the car across the salespeople.
sentences.zh: 所以我们商量好，罗恩也同意了，等我们拿到这一年租赁期的车之后，就按销售人员各自的销量把车的使用时间分摊开来。

sentences.en: There were four of us, including Ron, based off how many Macs we'd actually sold.
sentences.zh: 我们当时有四个人（包括罗恩），根据我们实际卖出的Mac数量来分配。

sentences.en: So we would, you know, take the year, divide it up by the number of Macs we sold, and you would get that percentage of time driving the car during the year.
sentences.zh: 我们会，你知道的，把这一年按我们卖出的Mac数量比例拆分，每个人就能按这个比例在这一年里分到开这辆车的时间。

sentences.en: And we thought that was fair.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得这很公平。

sentences.en: And so Ron flew down to Cupertino and met with Steve Jobs and got the car, got to drive the car back up from Cupertino, back up to Washington.
sentences.zh: 于是罗恩飞到库比蒂诺见了史蒂夫·乔布斯，拿到了车，然后一路把车从库比蒂诺开回了华盛顿。

sentences.en: And we divvied up the car, you know, who got to use it between the people on the team.
sentences.zh: 我们把车分配了一下，看看团队里谁能在什么时候使用它。

sentences.en: And I was taking the last section, and I think initially I had, like, two months for the car.
sentences.zh: 我分到的是最后一段，最初我好像有大约两个月的用车时间。

sentences.en: But I ended up getting more time because as people got expensive tickets driving this car, they, like, handed it off to the next person.
sentences.zh: 但我最后得到了更多时间，因为大家开这辆车吃了不少昂贵的罚单后，就把车转手给了下一个人。

sentences.en: They were like, okay, that just cost me a bunch of money, and my insurance rates are up.
sentences.zh: 他们就觉得：好吧，这车刚让我花了大把冤枉钱，保费也涨了。

sentences.en: You take it.
sentences.zh: 你拿去开吧。

sentences.en: And during that time, we also kind of traded off a bit where it was like, oh, well, I don't need the car for this week, and I've got something to do this week,
sentences.zh: 在这期间，我们还会互相调剂一下，比如：“哦，这周我不需要车，而我这周正好有点事，

sentences.en: so could I use the Porsche?
sentences.zh: 所以能把保时捷借我用用吗？”

sentences.en: We're all college kids for the most part, except for Ron.
sentences.zh: 除了罗恩，我们基本上都是大学生。

sentences.en: So I was the only person at this point who didn't have a ticket in the car, and I had three months to use the car.
sentences.zh: 所以到这个时候，我是唯一一个还没因这辆车吃过罚单的人，而我还有三个月的用车时间。

sentences.en: And I was down to the last two weeks on the lease, and I was living in downtown Seattle.
sentences.zh: 当时我的租赁期只剩最后两周了，我住在西雅图市中心。

sentences.en: And my now wife, Tricia, she was visiting her family down in Southern California.
sentences.zh: 我现在的妻子崔茜（Tricia）当时正去南加州探亲。

sentences.en: And I got invited to a party, so I called up a couple of friends of mine, Joe and Pat, and a cousin of mine, Trent, and said, hey, I got invited to this party.
sentences.zh: 我受邀去参加一个派对，于是我给我的两个朋友乔（Joe）和帕特（Pat），还有我的表弟特伦特（Trent）打了个电话，说：“嘿，我受邀去参加这个派对。”

sentences.en: Do you guys want to go?
sentences.zh: “你们想去吗？”

sentences.en: Like, that would be great.
sentences.zh: 他们说：“那太棒了。”

sentences.en: I'm like, I've got the Porsche.
sentences.zh: 我说：“我有保时捷。”

sentences.en: We'll drive to this party and have a good time.
sentences.zh: “我们开着保时捷去派对，好好玩上一场。”

sentences.en: So at the very last minute, Pat called and said, I can't go to the party, and he bails.
sentences.zh: 结果就在最后一分钟，帕特打电话说他去不了了，于是他放了鸽子。

sentences.en: And so it was just myself and Joe and Trent.
sentences.zh: 所以最后就只有我和乔、特伦特三个人。

sentences.en: And we're driving the Porsche to this party, and there's a windy road out by Issaquah, Washington, called Tiger Mountain, which is like a roller coaster.
sentences.zh: 我们在开着保时捷去派对的路上，华盛顿州伊萨夸（Issaquah）附近有一条盘山公路叫老虎山（Tiger Mountain），就像过山车一样。

sentences.en: It's up and down and banked curves and kind of notorious for being a fun drive.
sentences.zh: 忽高忽低还有倾斜的弯道，以极具驾驶乐趣而闻名。

sentences.en: And so I kind of unleashed the car going up the hill, and I was like, ah, that was fun.
sentences.zh: 于是我上山的时候有点放飞自我地踩了油门，心想：啊，太爽了。

sentences.en: Let's do it again.
sentences.zh: 再来一次。

sentences.en: So I turn around and start down the hill, and coming over a knoll around a bend, the car goes loose and starts to slide.
sentences.zh: 所以我调头开始下山，结果在一个弯道的山坡顶上，车子突然失控开始打滑。

sentences.en: And the roadway here, it's, you know, it's a fairly steep kind of mountainous area.
sentences.zh: 那里的路，你知道的，是一片相当陡峭的山区。

sentences.en: There's no guardrail, and if I went off on the outside of the curve, it was, you know, off a hill into big trees.
sentences.zh: 没有护栏，如果我在弯道外侧冲出去了，就会直接冲下山坡撞进大树里。

sentences.en: And so all I can remember thinking is, like, keep the car to the inside of the curve, like, no matter what happens, keep the car to the inside of the curve.
sentences.zh: 所以我能记住的想法就是：不管发生什么，一定要让车子贴紧弯道内侧，无论如何都要贴紧内侧。

sentences.en: And my memory was hitting the gravel, knowing that I was on the inside of the curve, the car just hitting the gravel, coming to a stop,
sentences.zh: 我的记忆停留在压到碎石的那一刻，我知道自己在弯道内侧，车子压到碎石后停了下来，

sentences.en: and me thinking, oh, phew, we're all fine, everything's okay.
sentences.zh: 当时我还心想：哦，呼，我们都没事，一切都好。

sentences.en: But my next memory is a firefighter yelling at me from outside the car to stay awake while they're prying the door off the car to get me out.
sentences.zh: 但我的下一个记忆是一名消防员在车外大喊大叫，让我保持清醒，同时他们正在撬开车门把我救出去。

sentences.en: And so, I don't remember the impact, but we swapped ends and went backwards into a telephone pole at an estimated speed of about 70 miles an hour.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不记得撞击时的情景了，但我们车身调头，以大约每小时70英里的估计时速倒着撞上了一根电线杆。

sentences.en: What the heck?
sentences.zh: 搞什么鬼？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, the telephone pole ripped through the rear axle of the car.
sentences.zh: 所以，电线杆直接撞断了车的后轴。

sentences.en: I have pictures of the, or negatives, at least I found them recently, of the car.
sentences.zh: 我有这张车的照片，或者说底片，至少我最近刚找到它们。

sentences.en: So, the telephone pole ripped through the rear axle.
sentences.zh: 电线杆直接撞穿了后轴。

sentences.en: It had a, the car had a sunroof.
sentences.zh: 车上有个，这车有个天窗。

sentences.en: The sunroof came off.
sentences.zh: 天窗飞出去了。

sentences.en: And, and it was, you know, I was driving, my cousin Trent was sitting in the, in the front passenger seat.
sentences.zh: 而且，当时我在开车，我表弟特伦特坐在副驾驶座上。

sentences.en: Wait, wait, the telephone pole went to the rear.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等，电线杆撞到了后面？

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, so, so, so, so, you hit, you hit the telephone pole.
sentences.zh: 所以，所以，所以，你们撞上了电线杆。

sentences.en: We, going backwards.
sentences.zh: 我们是倒着撞上去的。

sentences.en: Oh, going backwards, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，倒着撞的，好吧。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: We swapped ends and went backwards into the telephone pole.
sentences.zh: 我们车身调头，倒着撞上了电线杆。

sentences.en: It went to the rear.
sentences.zh: 撞到了后方。

sentences.en: So, and nobody died?
sentences.zh: 然后没人丧命？

sentences.en: And nobody died.
sentences.zh: 没有人丧命。

sentences.en: As I'm thinking in the back of my head, I'm like, Sean, please tell me that this is like a PG-13, like, and then we lost it.
sentences.zh: 当时我在脑海里直犯嘀咕：肖恩，求你了，告诉我这顶多算是个PG-13级，呃，然后我们就听呆了。

sentences.en: Because you were telling me all the names, and I was like, did we lose Trent?
sentences.zh: 因为你刚才报了所有人名，我当时就在想：特伦特不会没了吧？

sentences.en: Did we lose someone?
sentences.zh: 我们有人遇难了吗？

sentences.en: And that's why we're being so specific.
sentences.zh: 所以我们才讲得这么具体。

sentences.en: And so.
sentences.zh: 原来如此。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Everyone was alive.
sentences.zh: 大家都活着。

sentences.en: Everyone's alive.
sentences.zh: 大家都活着。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, so we'll walk through the injuries a little bit here.
sentences.zh: 那我们简单回顾一下大家的伤情吧。

sentences.en: So, so the, the sunroof popped and, and, and, and went back.
sentences.zh: 天窗被弹飞了，然后……

sentences.en: Um, uh, the roof crumpled, uh, the back seat got squished into the front seat.
sentences.zh: 呃，车顶严重塌陷，后排座椅被挤压到了前排座椅上。

sentences.en: So the, the back, Joe was sitting behind Trent.
sentences.zh: 所以，乔当时坐在特伦特后面。

sentences.en: So he's on the, on the, on the right side of the, if you're, you know, facing out the front windshield, he's on the right side of the car.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，如果你面向前挡风玻璃的话，他坐在车的右侧。

sentences.en: Uh, and so his seat got pushed, like smashed up against the seat in, in front of him.
sentences.zh: 呃，所以他的座位被向前推，死死贴在了他正前方的座椅上。

sentences.en: And he would have been crushed except the sunroof popped.
sentences.zh: 要不是天窗弹飞了，他肯定就被压扁了。

sentences.en: So he ended up pinned between the two seats, standing out the top of the car.
sentences.zh: 所以他最后被夹在两个座椅之间，上半身探出了车顶。

sentences.en: Um, and his only injury, uh, was a gash from kind of just before, just below his shoulder down to about his elbow, where his, as he got squished up, the roof crumpled down.
sentences.zh: 呃，他唯一的伤，是从肩膀下方一点、手肘上方一点的位置，一直到胳膊肘往下有一道大口子，因为在被挤压时，车顶塌陷了下来。

sentences.en: And so it left a sharp edge and it just gouged down his arm.
sentences.zh: 留下了锋利的边缘，直接把他的胳膊划开了一个大豁口。

sentences.en: Uh, so that was his injury.
sentences.zh: 呃，这就是他的伤。

sentences.en: Uh, uh, uh, uh, Trent had a concussion because of all things.
sentences.zh: 呃，特伦特脑震荡了，真是什么怪事都有。

sentences.en: There was a, uh, radar detector clipped on the visor that came off and clipped him in the forehead and gave him a good concussion from that.
sentences.zh: 遮阳板上夹着一个雷达探测器，飞下来砸中了他的额头，把他震得不轻，直接脑震荡了。

sentences.en: Um, uh, this was before air, airbags.
sentences.zh: 呃，当时还没有安全气囊。

sentences.en: So I rebounded and bounced off the steering wheel.
sentences.zh: 所以我整个人弹起来，撞到了方向盘上。

sentences.en: So I had a good concussion and I also, uh, uh, chipped a bone in my, in my shin.
sentences.zh: 因此我也得了严重的脑震荡，而且我的小腿骨也骨裂了。

sentences.en: Um, I'm not sure what I hit it on, but something, you know.
sentences.zh: 呃，我不确定我是撞到哪儿了，但肯定是某个地方，你知道的。

sentences.en: Kind of under the front of the car.
sentences.zh: 差不多在车头前部下方的位置。

sentences.en: And so, so yeah, so kind of my next memory after impact was coming to, with the firefighters out, uh, Trent had managed to get out of the car and,
sentences.zh: 所以，对，撞击之后的下一个记忆就是恢复意识，消防员们在外面，特伦特已经设法爬出了车外，

sentences.en: and then had managed to help Joe out of the car.
sentences.zh: 然后又设法把乔拉出了车外。

sentences.en: So they were already out of the car.
sentences.zh: 所以他们当时已经在车外了。

sentences.en: I was unconscious in the car and pinned.
sentences.zh: 而我在车里不省人事，还被卡住了。

sentences.en: And, um, uh, uh, uh,
sentences.zh: 然后，呃……

sentences.en: somebody nearby heard the squealing tires and it called the police and the police had come and they had called the fire department and the fire department had come.
sentences.zh: 附近有人听到刺耳的刹车声就报了警，警察赶到了，他们又叫了消防队，消防队也赶到了。

sentences.en: So I was unconscious for a while and, uh, fire department pried me out.
sentences.zh: 所以我昏迷了一阵子，消防队把我撬了出去。

sentences.en: So I have kind of these little flashes of memory from all of this, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我对这一切只有这些零星的记忆片段，对吧？

sentences.en: Like I said, I remember the car coming to a stop, not impacting anything.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我记得车子停下来了，没有撞到任何东西。

sentences.en: Then I remember the, uh, firefighters yelling at me.
sentences.zh: 然后我记得消防员对我大喊大叫。

sentences.en: Uh, uh, then my next memory is, is, uh, being out of the car and asking Joe and Trent if they were okay.
sentences.zh: 呃，再然后我的记忆就是已经出了车祸现场，正在问乔和特伦特他们有没有事。

sentences.en: And then I have a memory sitting in the back of the police squad car with a police officer asking if I'm okay.
sentences.zh: 然后我记得自己坐在警车后座，有个警察问我有没有事。

sentences.en: Um, uh, uh, and then I have a short memory of waking up in a hospital briefly and then a memory of being at my parents' house.
sentences.zh: 嗯……然后我记得自己短暂地在医院醒来，接着又记得自己回到了父母家。

sentences.en: And I don't know like who called my parents, but my parents had lived in the area.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是谁给我父母打的电话，但他们当时就住在附近。

sentences.en: And, uh, and so, so yeah, I was kind of in and out of it for a while.
sentences.zh: 嗯……总之，是的，我有一阵子神志不太清醒。

sentences.en: So accidents over, cars totaled, uh, uh, we're all okay.
sentences.zh: 所以事故结束了，车报废了，嗯……我们都没事。

sentences.en: I, uh, uh, uh, at my parents' house, I, I called Tricia and let her know that, oh, you know, the party we were going to, we never even made it there, crashed the Porsche,
sentences.zh: 我……在父母家，我给翠西打了电话，告诉她，你知道的，我们要去参加的那个聚会，我们根本没去成，保时捷撞毁了，

sentences.en: it's totaled.
sentences.zh: 车报废了。

sentences.en: And, and she asks, you know, what happened to Trent and Joe?
sentences.zh: 她问我，特伦特和乔怎么样了？

sentences.en: And I fill her in on those details.
sentences.zh: 我向她说明了情况。

sentences.en: And she goes, and what about Pat?
sentences.zh: 她又问，那帕特呢？

sentences.en: And the words out of my mouth were, oh, Pat didn't make it.
sentences.zh: 我脱口而出说，哦，帕特没能活下来。

sentences.en: And it took me a while because my wife just like went into hysterics on the other end of the phone, just like sobbing.
sentences.zh: 我花了好一会儿才解释清楚，因为我妻子在电话那头陷入了歇斯底里，一直在哭。

sentences.en: And she like, you know, couldn't, couldn't hear me.
sentences.zh: 她当时根本听不进我说的话。

sentences.en: And it was like, well, I'm trying to say, no, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 我当时就在想，不，不，不，不是那样的。

sentences.en: I meant like he canceled.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是说他取消行程了。

sentences.en: He didn't go to the party.
sentences.zh: 他没去参加聚会。

sentences.en: He wasn't in the car.
sentences.zh: 他不在车上。

sentences.en: So, so yes, she, she thought that, that I had, uh, uh, killed our friend Pat.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，她以为是我……杀害了我们的朋友帕特。

sentences.en: Uh, uh, but luckily that was not the case.
sentences.zh: 嗯……但幸运的是事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Pat, Pat had failed.
sentences.zh: 帕特……帕特没去。

sentences.en: Uh, uh, uh, I also think had Pat actually been in the car, I probably, you know, might not have totaled it because Pat, uh, was a very experienced, uh, uh, uh, race car driver.
sentences.zh: 嗯……我也觉得如果帕特当时真的在车里，我可能……就不会把车撞报废了，因为帕特是一位非常有经验的赛车手。

sentences.en: And he probably would have said, you're being an idiot here.
sentences.zh: 他可能会说，你真是个白痴。

sentences.en: So let's cut it out.
sentences.zh: 别再这么干了。

sentences.en: Um, uh, uh, so that all happens.
sentences.zh: 嗯……所以事情就是这样。

sentences.en: Um, uh, there's, you know, medical bills and hospital bills and a total Porsche and Apple's insurance company is a company called industrial indemnity.
sentences.zh: 嗯……还有医疗费、住院费，一辆报废的保时捷，而且苹果的保险公司叫工业赔偿公司。

sentences.en: And I get a letter from industrial indemnity that says, Hey, uh, we were just looking things up and you're not on the lease for this car.
sentences.zh: 我收到工业赔偿公司的一封信，上面写着，嘿，我们查了一下，这辆车的租赁合同上没有你的名字。

sentences.en: You had no business driving it.
sentences.zh: 你根本没资格开这辆车。

sentences.en: Uh, so we're suing you for the car, the hospital bills, the legal fees, all of this, which as a college student, this is a pretty daunting thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要起诉你，赔偿车款、住院费、律师费等等，作为一个大学生，这真是件让人头疼的事。

sentences.en: I think even as an adult, this would be a very daunting thing.
sentences.zh: 我想即使是成年人，遇到这种事也会非常头疼。

sentences.en: Um, but, uh, Ron, my boss at microcomputer systems, uh, wasn't, uh, an idiot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不过，我在微机系统公司的老板罗恩，他可不是个傻瓜。

sentences.en: And when he had gone to pick up the car, there had been a little ceremony with Steve jobs, handing him the keys to the car.
sentences.zh: 当他去取车时，史蒂夫·乔布斯还举行了一个小仪式，亲手把车钥匙交给了他。

sentences.en: And he gets to meet Steve jobs and he asked Steve, he said, Hey, Steve, I would like to use this car as incentive for my salespeople at the store.
sentences.zh: 他见到了史蒂夫·乔布斯，并问史蒂夫，他说，嘿，史蒂夫，我想把这辆车作为店里销售人员的激励奖品。

sentences.en: Would that be okay?
sentences.zh: 这样可以吗？

sentences.en: And Steve said, yeah, that would be okay.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫说，可以，没问题。

sentences.en: And Ron said, would you mind like writing that down?
sentences.zh: 罗恩说，你介意把它写下来吗？

sentences.en: And so Steve wrote, Ron can use the car as a sales incentive tool, Steve jobs on a cocktail napkin.
sentences.zh: 于是史蒂夫就在一张鸡尾酒餐巾纸上写道：罗恩可以将此车作为销售激励工具，史蒂夫·乔布斯。

sentences.en: And Ron kept the cocktail napkin.
sentences.zh: 罗恩把那张餐巾纸留了下来。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I tell Ron I'm getting sued and he's like, Oh no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 所以，我告诉罗恩我被起诉了，他说，哦不，不，不。

sentences.en: You had permission to drive the car.
sentences.zh: 你有权驾驶这辆车。

sentences.en: I wouldn't have let anybody drive the car without permission.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会在没有许可的情况下让任何人开这辆车。

sentences.en: I've got Steve jobs permission on this cocktail napkin.
sentences.zh: 我有史蒂夫·乔布斯在这张餐巾纸上写的许可。

sentences.en: And so I go into a, a meeting, um, uh, with the insurance company, uh, uh, and a bunch of lawyers.
sentences.zh: 于是我参加了一个会议，和保险公司的人还有一堆律师见面。

sentences.en: And I hadn't even hired my own lawyer at this point.
sentences.zh: 当时我甚至还没请自己的律师。

sentences.en: Uh, so it's like just to me on the other side of this table.
sentences.zh: 所以桌子对面就只有我一个人。

sentences.en: And, uh, you know, they're explaining to me basically how much money I'm going to owe.
sentences.zh: 他们向我解释我基本上要赔多少钱。

sentences.en: And I said, well, you know, I actually did have permission to drive the car and I slide this napkin across the table and, and they're like, you know, what's this?
sentences.zh: 我说，其实我确实有权驾驶这辆车，然后我把那张餐巾纸滑过桌面，他们问，这是什么？

sentences.en: And I'm like, that's, uh, Steve jobs, CEO of Apple.
sentences.zh: 我说，这是史蒂夫·乔布斯，苹果公司的CEO。

sentences.en: Who's gave me permission to, to drive this car.
sentences.zh: 他给了我驾驶这辆车的许可。

sentences.en: And they're like, yeah, no.
sentences.zh: 他们说，得了吧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: So, so I'm like, no, that's, that's what this is.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，这就是许可。

sentences.en: And so there's a bunch of like back and forth and conversation.
sentences.zh: 于是双方进行了一番来回的交涉。

sentences.en: And eventually somebody says, okay, I'm going to go make some phone calls.
sentences.zh: 最后有人说，好吧，我去打几个电话。

sentences.en: And it took like an hour, but somebody actually got ahold of Steve jobs and Steve jobs was like, Oh yeah, totally.
sentences.zh: 花了一个小时左右，有人真的联系上了史蒂夫·乔布斯，史蒂夫·乔布斯说，哦对，完全没错。

sentences.en: Like I gave permission.
sentences.zh: 我确实给了许可。

sentences.en: And that was it.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样解决了。

sentences.en: Thanks to Steve.
sentences.zh: 多亏了史蒂夫。

sentences.en: I, I ended up not getting sued.
sentences.zh: 我最终没有被起诉。

sentences.en: I can't believe this story is like pre all of you're in college at this point.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信这个故事发生在你们上大学之前。

sentences.en: I thought for sure.
sentences.zh: 我本以为……

sentences.en: This was like, uh, you know, like, so this is, this is pre everything like pre, pre Adobe, pre Google, pre Apple.
sentences.zh: 这是在一切之前，在Adobe、谷歌、苹果之前。

sentences.en: You're a cop as a college student.
sentences.zh: 你当时还是个大学生。

sentences.en: You got sued by Steve jobs or no, you got, you got sued by Apple and Steve jobs saved you.
sentences.zh: 你被苹果起诉了，或者说，你被苹果起诉了，然后史蒂夫·乔布斯救了你。

sentences.en: Uh, yeah, that's, that's, that's, that's a, you were, you were destined to, to, to go and have, uh, you know, one on, we're not one on ones, but like,
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，你注定要……进行一对一的交流，虽然不是那种正式的一对一，但……

sentences.en: that's amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太神奇了。

sentences.en: And, you know, sadly, I never got to tell the story to Steve jobs.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，我从来没机会把这个故事讲给史蒂夫·乔布斯听。

sentences.en: I have told the story to, uh, to Steve Wozniak.
sentences.zh: 我倒是把这个故事讲给史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克听过。

sentences.en: So we've got, we've got a good one.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有个很棒的故事。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Uh, uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯……是的。

sentences.en: So, so Steve Wozniak came and, uh, to a Mac hack one year.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克有一年来参加了Mac Hack大会。

sentences.en: We talked about Mac hack last time.
sentences.zh: 我们上次谈过Mac Hack。

sentences.en: So he came as a keynote speaker and hung out with everybody at Mac hack for, for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他作为主讲嘉宾来了，并在Mac Hack和大家待了很长时间。

sentences.en: So, so I had the chance there to tell him the story.
sentences.zh: 所以我有机会在那儿把这个故事讲给他听。

sentences.en: So, so, but, uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，是的。

sentences.en: Never had a chance to just tell Steve the story.
sentences.zh: 从来没机会直接把这个故事讲给史蒂夫听。

sentences.en: Let him know that.
sentences.zh: 让他知道。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I was the guy who totaled the Porsche.
sentences.zh: 我就是那个撞毁保时捷的家伙。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: Uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的。

sentences.en: I, uh, I got threatened to be sued one other time from Apple.
sentences.zh: 我有过另一次被苹果威胁起诉的经历。

sentences.en: And, um, this was, I worked at a little company, uh, micro or not microcomputer systems, orange micro, uh, you know, graduated from college.
sentences.zh: 当时我在一家小公司工作，不是微机系统公司，是Orange Micro，我刚大学毕业。

sentences.en: And I was, I think we talked about this some before.
sentences.zh: 我想我们之前谈过这个。

sentences.en: I was doing, uh, uh, printer driver stuff.
sentences.zh: 我在做打印机驱动程序相关的工作。

sentences.en: And, and I was reverse engineering Apple's, uh, printer drivers and was stuck on one.
sentences.zh: 我当时在对苹果的打印机驱动程序进行逆向工程，结果卡住了一个。

sentences.en: And I was communicating with Scott Boyd, who, he was also blue meanie.
sentences.zh: 我当时在和斯科特·博伊德交流，他也是“蓝色怪人”成员。

sentences.en: And he was somebody who I met at Mac hack.
sentences.zh: 他是我在Mac Hack认识的人。

sentences.en: And so we're still good friends to this day, but this was, he was at, in tech support at Apple at the time.
sentences.zh: 我们至今仍是好朋友，但他当时在苹果的技术支持部门工作。

sentences.en: And I was communicating with him and, uh, uh, uh, asking him how some things worked on the, one of the image writer drivers.
sentences.zh: 我当时在和他沟通，问他一些关于ImageWriter驱动程序的问题。

sentences.en: I don't remember if it was the LQ or the original image writer.
sentences.zh: 我不记得是LQ还是最初的ImageWriter了。

sentences.en: Uh, but it, uh, you know, I said,
sentences.zh: 但我对斯科特说，

sentences.en: said to Scott, I said, you know, instead of just like telling me all this stuff, it would be super handy if you could just send me the sources.
sentences.zh: 与其告诉我这些，如果你能直接把源代码发给我，那就太方便了。

sentences.en: And he was like, oh, sure.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，没问题。

sentences.en: Uh, so he sent me the sources to one of the drivers, which he should not have done.
sentences.zh: 于是他把其中一个驱动程序的源代码发给了我，这是他不该做的。

sentences.en: And so he then kind of realized afterwards that that probably wasn't the best thing to do.
sentences.zh: 事后他意识到这可能不是最好的做法。

sentences.en: So asked his manager, you know, is it okay that I sent this guy the sources?
sentences.zh: 于是他问他的经理，我把源代码发给这个人没问题吧？

sentences.en: It was like, oh, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 经理说，哦，绝对不行。

sentences.en: And so, so I got this, you know, nasty gram from, from Apple basically setting, threatening to sue me if I didn't destroy all, all the copies of the sources immediately.
sentences.zh: 于是我收到了一封来自苹果的措辞严厉的信，威胁说如果我不立即销毁所有源代码副本，就要起诉我。

sentences.en: And, and, and, and wiped them out.
sentences.zh: 并把它们彻底清除。

sentences.en: And I guess Scott almost got fired through this.
sentences.zh: 我想斯科特差点因此被解雇。

sentences.en: So we laugh about this from time to time that I almost got him fired too with my, uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以我们时不时会拿这件事开玩笑，说我差点也让他丢了工作。

sentences.en: You know, I just complied with the letter and, and it was not a, not a big issue.
sentences.zh: 我照信里的要求做了，这事儿也就没闹大。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I still can't get over.
sentences.zh: 我还是无法释怀。

sentences.en: I still can't get over the laSt.
sentences.zh: 我还是无法释怀那个结局。

sentences.en: We also should put some like disclaimer about, uh, if you ever win a Porsche or even if you don't win a Porsche and you have a vehicle, uh, and you look up to Sean,
sentences.zh: 我们还应该加个免责声明，如果你赢了一辆保时捷，或者即使没赢保时捷但有车，而且你很崇拜肖恩，

sentences.en: please do not, I think his behavior, uh, you know, only look up to his, uh, C++ coding abilities, not to his, uh, uh, irresponsible driving.
sentences.zh: 请千万不要模仿他，我认为他的行为……只学他的C++编程能力就好，别学他那不负责任的驾驶方式。

sentences.en: No, I, I think the lesson is if you have a Porsche, don't let Sean drive the Porsche.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为教训是：如果你有保时捷，千万别让肖恩开。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or any high performance vehicle for that matter.
sentences.zh: 或者任何高性能车辆都别让他开。

sentences.en: Um, uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯……是的。

sentences.en: And my, uh, uh, you know, the stories of my youth, my, uh, my cousin Trent and I were notorious.
sentences.zh: 关于我年轻时的故事，我和我表弟特伦特可是臭名昭著。

sentences.en: We're kind of almost every time we got together, it ended up in a, in an emergency room visit from like the time we were six on.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎每次聚在一起，最后都会以去急诊室告终，从我们六岁开始就是这样。

sentences.en: So, so there are many stories of the two of us, uh, uh, uh, kind of egging the other one on until it ends up in an emergency room visit.
sentences.zh: 所以关于我们俩的故事很多，我们总是互相怂恿，直到最后进了急诊室。

sentences.en: Sean, Sean parent, the, you know, the C++ luminary in his youth, just breaking bones, constantly concussing himself.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·帕伦特，那位C++领域的泰斗，年轻时却总是骨折、脑震荡。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know, I was, uh, you know, kid in the, in the, in the seventies and it was kind of free range, right?
